say:1:1534418001:0.text: Every Wildborn warrior must go on a treasure hunt. At the end, they'll find a precious reward.
say:1:1534418001:0.source_cn: 每一位雅库伯尔的勇士，都要踏上一场寻宝之旅。当勇士抵达...

say:2:1534418002:0.text: But the path isn't easy. It tests patience, courage, and wisdom.
say:2:1534418002:0.source_cn: 但寻宝之旅并不是轻松的旅途，而是对耐心、勇气、智慧的考验。

say:3:1534418003:0.text: This time, the hero of the tale is a warrior about to begin her journey...
say:3:1534418003:0.source_cn: 这次故事的主角，就是一个即将踏上寻宝之旅的勇士……
